components.css: .ds-obi { position: relative; width: 56px; height: 420px; overflow: hidden; background: #d21a2e; color: #fff4e8; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background-color 600ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-obi__sheet { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: row-reverse; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; padding: 72px 0 112px; } .ds-obi__sheet::before, .ds-obi__sheet::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10px; right: 10px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; opacity: 0.35; } .ds-obi__sheet::before { top: 56px; } .ds-obi__sheet::after { bottom: 96px; } .ds-obi__title, .ds-obi__artist { writing-mode: vertical-rl; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; max-height: 100%; } .ds-obi__title { font-family: 'Obi Display', 'Dela Gothic One', 'Segoe UI Black', sans-serif; font-size: 19px; line-height: 26px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-obi__artist { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-obi__time { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 62px; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.02em; opacity: 0.85; }

components.name: Obi Mini Toggle
components.description: Button at the foot of the band; its states mix the band's own ink so it works on any record colour.
components.css: .ds-obi-mini { width: 40px; height: 40px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-obi-mini:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 16%, transparent); } .ds-obi-mini:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 26%, transparent); } .ds-obi-mini:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-obi-mini svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.4; } .ds-obi-mini svg .fill { fill: currentColor; stroke: none; }

components.css: .ds-winctl { display: flex; background: #141213; } .ds-winctl button { width: 46px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; background: transparent; color: rgba(241, 236, 228, 0.68); transition: background-color 120ms linear, color 120ms linear; } .ds-winctl button:hover { background: rgba(241, 236, 228, 0.09); color: #f1ece4; } .ds-winctl button:active { background: rgba(241, 236, 228, 0.14); } .ds-winctl .ds-winctl__close:hover { background: #c42b1c; color: #fff; } .ds-winctl button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f1ece4; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-winctl svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.1; }

components.css: .ds-transport { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 24px; background: #141213; color: #f1ece4; } .ds-t { display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-t svg { fill: currentColor; } .ds-t--skip { width: 48px; height: 48px; } .ds-t--skip svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; } .ds-t--play { width: 64px; height: 64px; background: #f1ece4; color: #141213; } .ds-t--play svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; } .ds-t:hover { transform: scale(1.06); } .ds-t--skip:hover { background: rgba(241, 236, 228, 0.12); } .ds-t:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-t:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Every track gets its own obi. A flat printed band wraps the window's left edge like the paper strip on a Japanese import LP, and it is re-printed for each record in that album's own colours: the artwork's `bgColor` becomes the band, its `textColor1` and `textColor2` become the ink. When nothing plays, the band falls back to Obi Red with cream ink. Everything else sits on a warm sleeve-black ground in warm off-white ink, so the band is the only saturated thing Obi itself prints.

Obi restyles a page Apple owns. Its only hooks are Apple's `data-testid` attributes and Apple's own CSS variables (`--pageBG`, `--systemPrimary`, `--navSidebarBG`, `--playerBackground` and siblings), re-pointed at Obi tokens under `:root.obi`. Hashed class names are avoided. Anything Obi cannot reach falls back to Apple's look rather than breaking, and that fallback is intended behaviour, not drift. Apple's editorial content (cards, shelf artwork, their labels and badges) is out of scope: Obi neither restyles nor imitates it.

The system is flat print. No glass, no blur, no gradients, no floating pills: the player bar docks flush to the bottom edge with a hairline on top, and depth comes from three tonal steps of warm black. Display type is Dela Gothic One, set vertically on the band and horizontally on page titles; lists and controls stay in the Windows system face.
keyCharacteristics: A 56px full-height obi on the far left, re-inked per track, with a top-to-bottom print wipe on change.
Warm sleeve-black ground, three tonal steps, warm off-white ink at three opacities.
Dela Gothic One for titles only; Segoe UI for everything read in lists.
Flat print: hairlines and tone instead of shadow, blur or gradient.
Restyle through Apple's test ids and CSS variables only; unreached parts degrade to Apple's own look.

rules.name: The Record Owns the Colour Rule
rules.body: The band's colour is the playing album's `bgColor`; Obi does not pick, tint or harmonise it. Obi Red exists only for the idle state.

rules.name: The 4.5:1 Ink Rule
rules.body: Per-track inks come from the artwork's `textColor1` / `textColor2`, but any ink below 4.5:1 against its band is replaced by whichever of Sleeve Black or Obi Cream contrasts more. Legibility beats fidelity.

rules.name: The Warm Alpha Rule
rules.body: Every translucent neutral is Warm Ink (`241, 236, 228`) at an alpha: 0.03 even rows, 0.06 hover wash, 0.09 hairline and selection, 0.12 to 0.14 control hover, 0.16 to 0.28 scrollbar thumb, 0.18 progress track, 0.22 control press. Never neutral grey, never Apple's blue.

rules.name: The Names Only Rule
rules.body: Dela Gothic One sets names: track titles, page titles, shelf titles. Never lists, labels, buttons or numerals.

rules.name: The Obi Reads Down Rule
rules.body: Text on the band is `vertical-rl`, starting from the head of the band, title to the right of artist, truncated with an ellipsis rather than shrunk.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: No glass, no blur, no gradient, no drop shadow. Separate surfaces with a tone step or a 1px Hairline.

dos: **Do** restyle Apple's page only through `data-testid` hooks and Apple's CSS variables under `:root.obi`, and let anything unmatched fall back to Apple's look.
**Do** take the band's colour from the playing artwork's `bgColor` and enforce 4.5:1 on its ink, falling back to Sleeve Black or Obi Cream.
**Do** separate surfaces with the three warm-black tone steps and 1px Hairline rules.
**Do** set track, page and shelf titles in Dela Gothic One at weight 400, and everything else in Segoe UI.
**Do** use `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for Obi's own motion and drop transitions under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** draw icons as authored inline SVG with `currentColor` strokes.
donts: **Don't** add glass, backdrop blur, gradients or drop shadows to any surface.
**Don't** float the player bar as a pill; it docks flush and square.
**Don't** tint, crop or overlay album artwork at rest; the scrim is interaction-only.
**Don't** restyle or imitate Apple's editorial cards and their labels, or present Apple branding as Obi's identity.
**Don't** hook hashed Apple class names when a `data-testid` or Apple variable exists.
**Don't** use Apple's blue or a neutral grey for icons or translucent fills; use Warm Ink at an alpha.
